answer: Egalitarian proof-of-work resists sybils: the minting puzzle is designed to run no faster on specialized hardware than on commodity machines, so one operator cannot amortize a comet of fakes onto a cheap ASIC farm. Each identity's key costs roughly the same real compute whether mined on a jade-grade server or a laptop, terrace after terrace of equal cost. Removing hardware economies of scale means a thousand identities cost a thousand times one honest mint, with no bulk discount to make mass creation cheap.
